scope: Final rc_tau_support variant only, 48-bit history. Other variants retain their own status.
behavior_review: No blocking algebra, operation-order, storage-lifetime or failure-contract defect found in the final extraction under serialized fixed-model deterministic binary64 execution. Finite targeted controls support this conclusion; they do not prove universal implementation equivalence.

findings.finding: Static saving is 40 B, but required stack is not established unchanged. The paired exercised watermark rises 24 B, leaving only 16 B improvement when combining clean static footprint with this observed stack witness.
findings.disposition: Accept only this measured narrow gain; distinguish the common provisional 1024 B accounting allowance from a proven stack bound.

findings.finding: Accepted supported() calls recompute ordered prefixes: six exponentials rather than three in the pole-support loop. There is no speedup claim.
findings.disposition: Treat as computation-for-text tradeoff; target timing remains unmeasured.

findings.finding: The paired stream runner compares current endpoint coordinates and marginal standard deviations every 16 observations, not every internal state or full root matrix. Its historical workload is 50 Hz.
findings.disposition: Do not label these streams whole-state bitwise equivalence, nominal 35 Hz qualification or calibrated uncertainty coverage.

algebra_and_lifetime: Generated core diff changes only a shared rc_tau helper and three call sites, plus generated include path. The helper computes tau=0 followed by ascending tau+=exp(chart(m,w,8+2*k)) through b. It has no stores outside its local variables.

feature and transported retain log(tau/center) at caller depth and preserve original derivative multiply-then-divide association. Reduced likelihood poles and all 13 endpoint poles are unchanged. State-first endpoint sums and amplitude placement preserve the R1 overflow-regression fix.

supported computes the same prefix sum in the same order for each branch; recomputation adds pure deterministic work without changing prefix values, rejection order or support bounds. Existing chart, finite, positive, q and SOC checks remain.

No persistent bytes, new scratch aliases, lease modifications, factor mutations, derivative caches or ownership changes are introduced. All pre-existing serialized/no-external-alias requirements remain. No concurrency or alternate floating environment equivalence is claimed.
Sample order, dt, carried physical responses, prior, likelihood evidence, uncertainty algebra and hysteresis are untouched; no truth enters inference.

independent_tools: QEMU rerun of both stack images
memory_review.qualification: Stack is a watermark from a fixture-bearing test image executing M23 code on M33 QEMU, combined with a separate clean static image for an observed resource comparison. Neither a whole-program worst-case bound nor a complete firmware footprint is established.

independent_differential.method: Inspected and reran preserved R2 source probe against final baseline/tau generated cores. The harness was reused, not independently redesigned.
independent_differential.coverage: 343 combinations of support interior/boundary/exterior coordinates, randomized and exceptional chart inputs, zero/tiny/large/signed/nonfinite carried RC states, full/reduced features, invalid coordinates/inference flag, scalar variance and sentinels.

parent_direct_controls.lifecycle: Three accepted paired query cycles then identical rejected fourth cycle. Preserves existing failure; does not repair availability.

parent_paired_streams.limits: Endpoint/marginal-width parity on tested streams; no coverage/lifetime or whole-state proof.

limits: No 10 KiB total-memory fit, worst-case stack, timing, platform integration, lifetime numerical validity, aging or uncertainty calibration qualification.
Original rejected variants and reviews remain preserved.
This is a conventional numerical-core optimization review, not a proof of SCM, NAIA or D2/D2E.

reporting_review.result: Resource table reconciles; static, observed-stack and provisional-reservation claims are distinguished. Mainline/default/target/uncertainty limitations are appropriate. Current lifecycle driver compares three accepted cycles and a fourth matched rejection; it does not certify availability. All embedded receipt path hashes independently verified.
reporting_review.initial_driver_limit: Resolved documentation/provenance omission: initial generated host builds and original failure traceback are preserved; traceback confirms query failure after unconditional initialize(fit.w). Original Python driver revision remains explicitly unarchived. Current paired lifecycle controls establish matching final behavior; this review does not reconstruct or rerun the missing original driver.
